notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK check for the standard joined-federate MOM HLAobjectInstancesReflected value. It uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, HLAinteger32BE, HLAbyte, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and application class/member names. A publisher sends receive-order updates to three distinct objects; the subject federate receives two reflections for the first object, one for the second, and two for the third. A separate monitor federate queries and observes the subject's MOM object, so those MOM-value reflections do not contaminate the subject's reflected-object count. Direct values are checked at zero, one, one, and two, followed by periodic and direct values of three. Each application update is correlated with exactly one ordinary reflection callback. The FOM uses no DDM regions, and the test makes no DDM-accounting claim. No provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics are used.
